items.html: And the reason, know, that every aspect of the Mocha is called a ring [Izka], because the Mochin divide into four parts, which are HB and the Daat that includes HG, as above. And these four Mochin become four square Vavs, and a closed Mem is made, of "the growing of the government," called the ring, as mentioned in the Tikkunim, at the beginning of the fifth Tikkun, page 15, see there, how from the Botsina deKardinuta this ring is made, and it is like a square seal, called a ring. And there are male Mochin and female Mochin: the male Mochin, which are Aba, are called the pure ring [Izka Dachya], since they incline to Hesed, in the manner mentioned above in the pure air; and the Mochin of Ima are called the great ring [Izka Raba], in the secret of "What will you do for Your great name?"
